preview.tournamentOverview: El Cardonal at Diamante is a new PGA Tour venue that rewards ball-striking and short-game precision over raw distance. The course's firm, fast conditions and strategic bunkering place a premium on approach play and scrambling, making SG: Approach (20%) and SG: Around-the-Green (10%) critical differentiators. This event carries elevated importance as the final fall swing stop before the signature events, offering a last chance for players to lock in 2025 status and PGA Tour cards.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model weights SG: Total at 30% to capture overall form, while SG: Approach (20%) and SG: Off-the-Tee (15%) reflect the course's emphasis on iron play and controlled tee shots. SG: Putting (15%) and SG: Around-the-Green (10%) round out the skill set, with Bogey Avoidance (4%) and Birdie/Bogey Ratio (3%) added to account for the tight scoring windows created by firm greens. Driving Accuracy (3%) is down-weighted because the layout's width mitigates the penalty for slight misses.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by combining model rank with power rank gaps: top-10 model names with power ranks inside the top-40 are our core outright and top-10 targets. Mid-tier names (model ranks 11-20) with strong SG: Approach or SG: Around-the-Green spikes become our top-20 and top-30 plays. 4 strokes but whose power rank lags by more than 30 spots is flagged for low-stake outright speculation only.
